reviews.text: There are no words, a wonderful cafe on Karon, very pleasant staff, the barista is the best. Huge greetings to you, we didn't have time to say goodbye, but you will always stay on our trip to Thailand. Pet the cat for us! The coffee is fantastic, they rarely make it in Russia, you're a great guy, as soon as we get back, we'll definitely visit you. Good luck to you! (This is the guy and the girl who came to see you every day)

If you are in Karon area and 420 coffee is your thing, I’d highly recommend stopping by here. The owner is very friendly and the prices are fair. There is area for shared working space or just to chill with good music. The cat is a super cute add-on. Spent about 30 minutes here and the coffee tasted very good as well.

Excellent pour over coffee.
The best in Kata / Karon area.

Highly reccomend. Always get the Thai beans when in Thailand.
